mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PROJECT' AS targetType, PROJ_ID AS targetId, PROJ_NM AS title, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM AS delDt, LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS delUsrId FROM TB_PROJECT WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CONTRACT', CONT_ID, CONT_NM, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM TB_CONTRACT WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CUSTOMER', CUST_ID, CUST_NM, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM TB_CUSTOMER WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ASSIGNMENT', ASSIGN_ID, ASSIGN_TITLE, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BILLING', BILL_ID, BILL_TITLE, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM TB_BILLING WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EMP', EMP_ID, EMP_NM, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM TB_EMP WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SALES', SALES_ID, SALES_TITLE, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM TB_SALES WHERE DEL_YN = 'Y' ) AS TEMP WHERE 1=1
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND targetType = #{targetType}
ORDER BY delDt DESC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

choose.when: UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE PROJ_ID = #{targetId}
UPDATE TB_CONTRACT SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE CONT_ID = #{targetId}
UPDATE TB_CUSTOMER SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE CUST_ID = #{targetId}
UPDATE TB_ASSIGNMENT SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE ASSIGN_ID = #{targetId}
UPDATE TB_BILLING SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE BILL_ID = #{targetId}
UPDATE TB_EMP SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE EMP_ID = #{targetId}
UPDATE TB_SALES SET DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE SALES_ID = #{targetId}
